title: Era of the Grand Cycle
summary: Start of the Grand Cycle (Kya-tse, Chi-tran, Saros), a 3,600-year era of 60 cycles of 60 years.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-26. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-26: Era of the Grand Cycle: 3177/3176 B.C."
chronologies.note: The 3,600-year Grand Cycle (60 cycles of 60 years) of the Babylonians, Chinese and Hindus; CFAH-3 concludes it was originally counted from the same year as the Saptarshi era. Chinese reckoning gives 3174 B.C.; many Chinese scholars use 2697 B.C. for the first cycle.
